scientific_integrity: The critical unweighted operator is unbounded. Finite checker exercises are not taken as a substitute for the analytic proof. No independent mathematical audit or validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Only the unnormalized beta-moment family, classical Dirichlet Hilbert norm and positive-real parameter are treated. Fixed singular-value ranks only; no uniform high-rank expansion. Historical priority beyond searched literature is uncertain. Analytical proof has no independent validation.
title: Bessel-zero spectral blow-up at the critical Dirichlet Hankel boundary
